concept_attempts.feedback: Selected major form: one blunt irregular mineral cone, small horizontal oval inset and two splayed dark clefts. Concept clefts extend too far down and inset is duller than original; GLB must use shorter legacy clefts and paler blue. Fine microrelief and exact engineering remain authored.

issues: Retain one oval inset, short downward-splaying clefts and continuous triangular body.
Connected cellular normal-map seams read as assembled panels; replace with sparse broken meandering mineral cracks and quiet grain.
Broaden/blunt the summit and deepen the dark cleft fill so it reads recessed rather than applied rails.
Body proportions, quiet broken veins and short clefts retained.

Surface still reads too soft/plain versus original and concept. Add sparse shallow irregular chips with exposed mineral faces and slightly stronger physical grain; no structural panels or invented machinery.
Rear view exposes a vertical material discontinuity from nonperiodic texture edges. Make colour/packed/normal fields tile continuously in U and wrap the normal derivative.
Keep the validated body geometry, short clefts, oval inset and physical wear cuts unchanged.

final_review: Final independent GLB retains one continuous blunt mineral mound, one horizontal pale-blue oval and two short downward-splaying dark clefts. The clearer legacy cleft length and colour take priority over concept embellishment. Actual feedback removes closed cellular panel-like normal seams, blunts the summit and seats dark fill deeper in the physical cuts. Sparse shallow wear chips expose lighter alloy without adding structural panels. Periodic U material fields remove the rear texture discontinuity.
limitations: Exact profiles, socket engineering, hidden surfaces and detailed weathering are authored from limited fixed views.
The original functional text calls this Silence while catalogue identity is Fa-lanth; its spiritual purpose and the physical role of inset/clefts remain unknown.
No source metric height, calibrated game scale/state, Android performance or final user artistic acceptance claimed.
